h: רֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ אִיָּר, ה׳ Rosh Chodesh Iyar, 5

p: "He made the letter Vav reign over contemplation, etc.,
and the right kidney in the soul, etc."
The difference between contemplation and thought
is that thought is in the brain
and contemplation is in the heart,
And in the heart there is
"the heart of the wise man at his right
and the heart of the fool at his left."
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה ה, ב)
that HaKadosh Baruch Hu is called
'The Rock of my heart and my portion
And as for the Midrash saying
between Kudsha Brich Hu and the Shechinah.
And the pasuk indicates the same,
since it mentions the Name Elokim;
the Master of all the powers,
and that is the Name Adnus,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א קעב, א)
through which the work of the world is done."
And it is stated in the holy Zohar (ibid. 151a)
from the side of the Yovel,
וְשַׁרְיָא בָהּ יִרְאָה (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א ה, ב)
and fear dwells in her" (Zohar I 5b),
וְנִקְרָא לֵב (כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ יוֹמָא עב, ב)
and it is called "heart" (as stated in Yoma 72b),
And it says "He made the letter Vav reign over contemplation,"
meaning that the light of the Name Havayah should shine forth.
This is along the lines of what is written
"Fortunate is he who makes them a dwelling
in the two chambers of the heart,
and the yetzer hara is cleared out from there."
For the heart has two chambers,
between the two openings of the heart
וּכְנֶגֶד זֶה שׁוֹכֵן ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ בַּלֵּב,
and opposite it Hashem Yisbarach dwells in the heart:
"the heart of the wise man is at his right."
For this is what they said (Sukkah 52b):
and were it not that HaKadosh Baruch Hu
"Hashem will not abandon him into his hand" (Tehillim 37:33).
"He made the letter Vav reign over contemplation":
the unification of the six extremities;
all of the first three sefiros,
"and you will find knowledge of Elokim";
and when one merits the upper Shabbos,
the yetzer hara is cleared out from there
The month of Nissan was created with the letter Hei,
for then they accepted the yoke of His Kingship;
and they merited the revelation of Havayah:
פָּנִים בְּפָנִים דִּבֶּר ה׳ עִמָּכֶם [דְּבָרִים ה, ד],
"Face to face Hashem spoke with you" (Devarim 5:4).
And the month of Iyar comes with the letter Vav,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת וַיִּקְרָא),
(as written in the holy Zohar at the beginning of Parshas Vayikra),
and "the lip of truth shall be established forever" —
that it should be fixed for all eternity.
For in Iyar was the preparation
and drink the water of the well,
and the Torah will settle into their bodies."
Also in Iyar there took place
and this was preparation for Matan Torah,
by their eradicating the yetzer hara,
for Amalek is the evil inclination
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קס, א),
and this is preparation for Matan Torah.
For in Iyar "He made the letter Vav reign" —
"Hashem will not abandon him into his hand" (Sukkah ibid.);
And in Sivan there was the unification:
Havayah dwells among the Children of Yisrael,
and the yetzer hara is cleared out from there:
And it lists "the right kidney in the soul";
for of the kidneys, there are two:
and one counsels him for evil,
and it stands to reason that the good one is at his right
and the evil one at his left"
that the organs Hashem Yisbarach created
in the heart of the fool
so that he should have a longing for Torah,
as it will be in the future;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בְּזֹהַר חֵלֶק א קלח, א
"Were it not for the yetzer hara,
there would be no joy in Torah study."
And this is what is said in Midrash Tanchuma (Bereishis 7):
"You are the one who makes it evil."
was created so that a person should subdue his yetzer
from the heart of the fool at his left.
And the month of Iyar was created in the soul
"Behold, You desire truth in the inward parts" —
and "the lip of truth shall be established forever" —
that the holiness should remain for all eternity.
in which is the preparation for Matan Torah, as stated.
And the version of the Geonim reads:
"In Nissan He made the letter Hei reign over sight,
and in Iyar He made the letter Vav reign over hearing."
The matter is as I heard
in Nissan it was only out of Hashem's kindness,
and the revelation was only temporary,
on the night of Yetzias Mitzrayim,
And at the splitting of the Yam Suf
"A maidservant saw at the Sea, etc.";
It is like the strength of Chassidus at its beginning,
of which our Rebbe, Reb Bunim zt"l, said
"Do not say that the former days
כִּי לֹא מֵחָכְמָה שָׁאַלְתָּ עַל זֶה,
for it is not out of wisdom that you ask about this" —
for it comes only as a loan:
And in Sivan they merited it as a possession.
that Iyar was created with the letter Vav.
For it is written (Responsa of Maharam Alashkar 74)
in the name of Rav Hai Gaon z"l
that the Vav is a connector:
from the term "the hooks (vavei) of the pillars,"
and the shape of the Vav, too,
is like the hooks of the pillars;
So too the month of Iyar joins
the month of Nissan and the month of Sivan,
so that in Sivan they merit as a possession
what they merited in Nissan by sight.
And this is why it says
"in Nissan with sight and in Iyar with hearing":
hearing is acceptance in the heart,
as we find in the Gemara:
"Lo shemia li" — "I have not heard it" —
And this is why it says
in Iyar "He made the letter Vav reign over hearing."
And the version of the Geonim reads:
in the month of Iyar, "the gall in the soul."
The matter is according to what is said
and when Hashem Yisbarach created the gall,
This is according to what is said
to rouse oneself against the yetzer hara,
the good inclination against the evil inclination."
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (תַּעֲנִית ד, א)
"A young Torah scholar who boils with anger —
it is the Torah that makes him boil,
This is the abundance of wisdom
rousing itself against the abundance of anger.
For in Nissan Yisrael merited the light,
but the preparation for Matan Torah
For this comes the month of Iyar,
and to rouse oneself against it;
and through this they will merit in Sivan
a wise heart from Hashem Yisbarach's side,
from the side of the Tree of Life.
And the version of the Raavad z"l reads:
and in Iyar, the left hand."
This is according to what is said
is from the side of Chesed,
and it was foretold to Avraham Avinu,
And Iyar has the letters of "yira,"
for it is from the side of Gevurah;
for then is the time of the Sefirah,
which is "to purify us of our kelipos, etc.,"
and guarding against the negative commandments,
so that if you come to rebel,
know that you are one who fears,
and one who fears does not rebel."
The main force of the days of the Sefirah
is in the month of Iyar:
for in Nissan there is the holiness of the Yom Tov,
which comes from the side of Chesed and love,
and in Sivan there is holiness
the essential days of the Sefirah are in Iyar,
for then is the time of effort on man's part,
in order to purify and sanctify himself.
This is the trait of Yitzchak,
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קעה, ב)
And it is stated in the holy Zohar (II 175b):
father and mother with the son between them,"
זֹהַר הַאֲזִינוּ חֵלֶק ג רצ, א),
And the month of Iyar corresponds to Binah,
And this is why it says
"He made the letter Vav reign over the left hand":
it is Gevurah, which issues from Binah,
to rectify through teshuvah and to be purified.
derives it from what is written (Vayikra 16:19):
"And he shall purify it and sanctify it" —
for the main effort is with fear,
"What does Hashem your G-d ask of you
and afterward love comes on its own
in the name of our master Rabbi Ber zt"l:
"for such is the way of a man, etc."
"Anochi" is the sum of the positive commandments,
is the sum of the negative commandments.
Torah learning was implanted in their hearts,
the yetzer hara was uprooted from their hearts
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה א, ב
And although the Raavad z"l did not mention,
of the twelve faculties of man,
their foundation is sight, hearing, etc." —
it appears that sight corresponds to the month of Nissan
as in the version of the Geonim;
whereas according to the Arizal's version
listing Reuven for the month of Nissan,
עַל שֵׁם כִּי רָאָה ה׳ בְּעָנְיִי
named for "for Hashem has seen my affliction"
and Shimon for the month of Iyar,
who lists the tribes in the order of the banners,
listing Reuven for the month of Tammuz
and Shimon for the month of Av,
reads for the month of Tammuz:
The point is that Nissan is from the side of Chesed,
and from the side of love;
this is "with sight," corresponding to Reuven,
עַל שֵׁם כִּי רָאָה ה׳ בְּעָנְיִי
named for "for Hashem has seen my affliction,
for now my husband will love me" —
And then they merited "a maidservant saw
and although afterward the light was hidden,
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב ס, א),
nevertheless, the desire remained from the seeing,
כִּי שָׁמַע ה׳ כִּי שְׂנוּאָה אָנֹכִי וְגוֹ׳,
"for Hashem has heard that I am hated, etc.";
for then is the time of effort on man's part
that we not be "hated" for our deeds;
and the hearing is to rectify,
so that we not be hated.
Likewise, Shabbos was given at Marah
(as stated in the Mechilta, Beshalach, Vayisa 1,
And regarding Shabbos it is written (Tehillim 92:2):
"It is good to give thanks (lehodos) to Hashem";
whoever confesses and forsakes his sin is saved, etc.;
and likewise in the Midrash (Bereishis Rabbah 22:13):
כָּךְ הוּא כֹּחָהּ שֶׁל תְּשׁוּבָה וְכוּ׳,
"Such is the power of teshuvah, etc.;
'A psalm, a song for the Shabbos day,' etc."
the main effort is with fear, as stated.
But from Hashem Yisbarach's side, first comes
"Anochi," the root of the positive commandments,
the root of the negative commandments.
נֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם,
corresponding to the holiness of Yitzchak Avinu, alav hashalom,
וּבַבֹּקֶר נֶגֶד אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם,
and the morning meal corresponding to Avraham Avinu, alav hashalom;
from man's side the effort is with fear,
created the souls of the Avos
Avraham was born first and afterward Yitzchak.
So too in Nissan they merited light
and at the splitting of the Yam Suf,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר [שְׁמוֹת טו, כב] מִדְבַּר שׁוּר
as it says (Shemos 15:22), "the wilderness of Shur,"
and as stated in the holy Zohar (ibid.),
and only the desire remained with them.
"I remember for you the kindness of your youth, etc.,
your following Me in the wilderness";
אַךְ מִכָּל מָקוֹם יֵשׁ עוֹד הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע
But nevertheless there is still the yetzer hara,
for this comes the month of Iyar,
וְזֶה הֲכָנָה לְחוֹדֶשׁ סִיוָן מַתַּן תּוֹרָה
This is preparation for the month of Sivan, Matan Torah,
when the Angel of Death was nullified,
The intent of all the versions is one:
which is the essence of the days of Sefirah,
is "to purify us of our kelipos, etc."
And this is "He made reign over contemplation":
to be sanctified with supernal holiness,
as it says, "And he shall purify it and sanctify it"
one merits holiness for the future.
so that we not be hated for our deeds;
and this is the preparation for Matan Torah.
and through this one merits teshuvah;
